payload.question: Did the emergency reserve stay where the council said it would?
payload.label: The emergency reserve to stay at £8.249m, above the £5.5m floor

target.display: "The General Fund unallocated reserve, is expected to remain at £8.249 million over the life of the Medium-Term Financial Strategy, which remains above the prudent minimum level." — Cabinet, 5 February 2025

payload.evidence: The council said in February 2025 that its emergency reserve would stay at £8.249m. The draft accounts published in June 2026 show exactly £8.249m at 31 March 2026 — the fourth year-end running at that figure.
